---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or feature for JACAMENO
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem/Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it would address.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## ✨ Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Be as detailed as possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you thought of any alternative solutions or features? Describe them here.

## 📊 Impact

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Can't enjoy the game without it
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just a suggestion

## 🎮 Which Version?

Which version(s) of the game should have this feature?
- [ ] Web version
- [ ] Android version
- [ ] Both

## 🖼️ Mockups/Examples

If applicable, add mockups, sketches, or examples from other games.

## 🤔 Additional Context

Add any other context or information about the feature request here.

## ✔️ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues/features to make sure this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] I have described the feature clearly
- [ ] This feature aligns with the game's core mechanics

---

**Thank you for helping us improve JACAMENO! We appreciate your creative ideas.**
